question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Clandestine
solution:
The correct answer is: **Open**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Clandestine"** refers to something done in secrecy or kept hidden, especially for illicit purposes. (गुप्त)
 
 
• **Example:** They held clandestine meetings to plan their strategy without anyone knowing.
 
 

 
• **"Open"** refers to something that is not hidden, easily accessible, or publicly known. It stands in direct opposition to the idea of being secretive or hidden. (खुला)
 
 
• **Example:** The discussion was held in an open forum, allowing everyone to participate freely.
 
 

 
• Hence, the antonym of **"Clandestine"** is **"Open"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Open**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Long** (लंबा): Refers to something that has great length or duration.
 
 
• **Example:** The journey was long and tiring, but it was worth the effort.
 
 

 
• **Secret** (गुप्त): Something that is hidden or not disclosed to others, similar in meaning to "clandestine."
 
 
• **Example:** She kept the secret locked away in her heart for years.
 
 

 
• **Boring** (उबाऊ): Refers to something dull, uninteresting, or lacking excitement.
 
 
• **Example:** The movie was so boring that I fell asleep halfway through.
